name: LearnHubble AI
title: A personalized teaching and learning platform with AI interaction
lead: While learners work through lectures and assignments, AI offers explanations and hints the moment they need help.

points.title: Portfolio
points.text: Compares accumulated academic competencies with the competencies a target job requires.

points.title: Assignment hints
points.text: When writing stalls, gives structure-and-condition hints, not answers.

points.title: Competency Map
points.text: Helps trace the causes of difficulty through lectures and competencies linked by 1EdTech CASE.

points.title: Classroom AI panel
points.text: Offers explanations, quizzes, and materials in sections the instructor designed.

principle: Learners write their own answers, and instructors confirm interventions and what is applied.
